result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the bottom navigation bar has a clear visual defect: a dark horizontal bar/gesture-indicator overlaps the search and orders icons, obscuring them. The second 'Popular right now' card is also cut off without a visible title, but that falls under viewport truncation and is excluded.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick dark horizontal bar (likely the system home/gesture indicator or a misplaced divider) is drawn on top of the Search and Orders tab icons, partially covering them so they are hard to recognize and appear broken.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area/inset padding to the navigation bar so the system gesture indicator does not overlap the tab icons, or remove/reposition the stray divider element so all four tab icons are fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom navigation tabs have icons only with no text labels, and only the Home tab is tinted; the overlapping element makes the Search and Orders tabs even less distinguishable.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon and ensure a clear active/inactive state so navigation targets are identifiable.
